quote: A man with outward courage dares to die; a man with inner courage dares to live.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Because one believes in oneself, one doesn't try to convince others. Because one is content with oneself, one doesn't need others approval. Because one accepts oneself, the whole world accepts him or her.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Do not go about worshipping deities and religious institutions as the source of the subtle truth. To do so is to place intermediaries between yourself and the divine, and to make of yourself a beggar who looks outside for a treasure that is hidden inside his own breast.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: He who controls others may be powerful, but he who has mastered himself is mightier still.
author: Lao Tzu.

quote: If you are depressed, you are living in the past. If you are anxious, you are living in the future. If you are at peace, you are living in the present.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Respond intelligently even to unintelligent treatment.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: The greatest gift you have to give is that of your own self-transformation
author: Lao Tzu

quote: The Tao does not take sides; it gives rise to both yin and yang. All is welcome, light and dark.
author: Lao Tse

quote: The Tao doesn't take sides; it gives birth to both yin and yang. All is welcome, both light and dark.

quote: To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders
author: Lao Tzu

quote: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
author: Lao Tzu
